data.title: Speeding fine notice, €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The City of Musterau fines office issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 30 April 2026. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driving register. It was formally delivered on 21 May 2026.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h was allowed. The fine is €70 plus €25 fees and €3.50 costs, and you get 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. You can either accept it and pay, or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office. The app shows the objection deadline, which counts from the delivery date. Without a timely objection the decision becomes final and can be enforced. Payment is due within two weeks after it becomes final (Rechtskraft). If you are unsure whether to object, consider getting legal advice.
